cases.title: 顶层列表与明确结束标记
cases.guidance: For a page-number GET response with items, has_next and total: inspect /items, /has_next and /total. Map each requested field relative to an actual item. Use only query parameters present in the observed request. Verify total and unique identifiers across pages.

cases.title: 别名字段映射
cases.guidance: A rows array may use sku and title where the requested outputs are id and name. Confirm observed types and meaning before mapping. The page parameter may be p. Use /more or /total only when present. Never copy an example request identifier.
